title: Recording note and Williams's current band at Leroy's
summary: Russell notes the date, place and tape; Williams names the members of his band at Leroy's.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I'll make a note on the tape here that we're interviewing Mr. Dave Williams at his home, 1901 Milton, isn't it? Up near St. Bernard and the date is July the 2nd, 1961. So, when we go to transcribe this in there, look at what tape it is.

Now, this band you're playing at Leroy's on Burmese Street with, Dave, is that your band? You're leading that band? That's my band, yeah. Uh-huh. And you've got Sam Dutre in there? And who else is in the band with you?
Willie Joss, Josh Willis at least. You know Josh Willis the trumpet man? Uh-huh. And Marvin, Tram Martin, Justin Joss on the drum. And then McNeil Groh was on the bass.
Did you say also Kimball sometimes?
Kimball played banjo sometimes. Yeah, Groh played bass.
